# Tyler Hagan · Product Designer & Design Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Tyler Hagan, a Berlin-based senior product designer and
> design engineer with 15+ years across design and front-end development, the
> last eight in the residential solar / energy space. Most recently Designer
> at Enpal Energy (Mar–Sep 2026), where he initiated, designed and built the
> Enpal design family (Enpal DS, NEMO, VERSO, FOLIO) end to end. Open to
> senior and staff-level product design roles.

## Pages

- [Work](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/): index of case studies.
  - [One Foundation, Three Products](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/work/enpal-product-work):
    the Enpal design family and the customer portal, marketing site and
    back-office tool built on it (ship times −20%, kick-off times −50%).
  - [Offer Tool](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/work/offer-tool): multi-national
    sales tool (72% faster offer creation, 42% higher conversion).
  - [Field Service App](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/work/field-service): critical
    data entry raised from 38% to 97%.
  - [Solar Design Studio](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/work/solar-designer): v2
    concept for a solar sales and planning tool, one plan for planner and customer.
  - [Energy Monitoring](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/work/monitoring-app): customer
    monitoring app.
- [About](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/about): background, approach, philosophy,
  and career timeline.
- [CV](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/cv): full CV as semantic HTML with schema.org
  JSON-LD; also available as a two-page ATS-safe PDF at
  https://tylerhagan.co.uk/tyler-hagan-cv.pdf
- [Colophon](https://tylerhagan.co.uk/colophon): how the site itself is built,
  covering the one-source CV pipeline, client-side encrypted case studies, and
  receipts.

## Notes

- Case studies covering confidential employer work are encrypted client-side
  (AES-256-GCM) and unlock with a password shared on request.
- Contact is via the form on the site; no email address is published.
- The site sets no cookies and does no cross-site tracking. Page views are
  counted with cookie-free, first-party Vercel Web Analytics.
